Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly relieve bone on bone knee pain with a simple decompression traction exercise.

This exercise will focus on opening up the knee, or reducing pressure, by using just a towel. It's especially good for knee arthritis, and may give relief within seconds.

Let us know how it works for you!
